b01.note: gamma(0.999999)=707 (calc). Draft said 'every star crowds into one ring'; our own simulation and McKinley & Doherty 1979 show no ring, so reworded to 'one patch of light ahead' (aberration puts all but the rearmost stars within ~1 deg).

b02.note: Open loop; payoff in b23-b27 (unshielded lethal dose at 90%, a lower bound). Trimmed 'But' for hook length.

b03.note: ISS mass 419,725 kg (NASA) -> 'about 420 tonnes'. The dial is the scenario device.

b04.note: Lists the scenario speeds (definitions, not measurements). Shortened for captions.

b06.note: Star field = HYG v4.0 catalogue (~28,500 stars to V=7.6) transformed per frame with aberration, Doppler and beaming (physics.ts). 'tens of thousands' true; diffuse glow stand-in disclosed in research.md.

b07.note: gamma = dt_Earth / dt_ship for constant cruise speed (special relativity). HUD shows it.

b09.note: Parker Solar Probe ~430,000 mph = 192 km/s (NASA), the fastest human-made object; 29,979/192 = 156.

b10.note: (gamma-1)*365.25 d = 1.84 d per ship year -> 'about 2 extra days'.

b11.note: At 0.1c a sideways star appears at acos(0.1)=84 deg (6 deg forward); D ahead 1.11 (bluer), behind 0.90 (redder). Reworded into shorter sentences for captions; meaning unchanged.

b12.note: Typical interstellar density ~1 atom/cm3 (NASA Genesis). 'about' because the local medium is less dense (stated in assumptions).

b13.note: (gamma-1) m_p c^2 = 4.73 MeV; NIST PSTAR CSDA range of a 5 MeV proton in water is 0.36 mm, so a 4.7 MeV proton stops in under half a millimetre.

b14.note: KE = (gamma-1) M c^2 = 1.9e20 J; 592 EJ/yr world (Energy Institute 2025) -> 0.32 yr = 3.9 months. Minimum: perfect engine, no fuel (stated).

b15.note: 4.37 ly / 0.1c = 43.7 yr Earth time (ship 43.5 yr). 'old person' is rhetoric for a 43-year trip.

b18.note: Aberration: theta=90 deg -> cos theta' = beta = 0.5 -> 60 deg. Draft said '60 degrees ahead of you', which could read as 'moved by 60 deg'; reworded to '60 degrees from straight ahead'.

b19.note: Sun T_eff 5772 K (NASA) x D_ahead 1.732 = 9,997 K -> 10,000; behind /1.732 = 3,333 -> 3,300. Visible flux behind drops (calc check).

b20.note: (1.155-1) x 938.3 MeV = 145 MeV, inside the 70-250 MeV proton-therapy band (MD Anderson).

b21.note: Draft said 'straight through a human body': wrong, a 145 MeV proton stops after ~15 cm of water (PSTAR, 150 MeV -> 15.76 cm). Now 'reach deep inside'. 'less than 16 centimeters' holds since 145 < 150 MeV.

b22.note: KE/world = 9.9 yr; Alpha Cen 8.74 yr Earth, 7.57 yr ship (d/v, d/(gamma v)).

b23.note: Payoff of the b02 open loop begins.

b24.note: (2.294-1) x 938.3 = 1.21 GeV > rest energy 938 MeV ('more energy than its own mass', mass meaning rest-mass energy). 'don't stop in a water tank' consistent with the 83 cm interaction length (b25).

b25.note: PDG: nuclear interaction length of water 83.3 g/cm2 = mean free path before an inelastic nuclear collision; hadronic collisions produce secondaries (showers). 'multiplies' is rhetoric for secondary production.

b26.note: Dose rate >= n v S_min = 1e6/m3 x 0.9c x 1.992 MeV cm2/g = 8.6 Gy/s (lower bound; showers add more). LD50/30 lower end 4 Sv (NRC) -> 0.46 s < 0.5 s. Unshielded is stated.

b27.note: Interpretation of b26; sugar cube ~1 cm3 matches the 1 atom/cm3 density.

b28.note: Scenario assumption (shielding assumed from here), consistent with b25.

b29.note: cos theta' = 0.9 -> 25.8 deg -> 26; half sky = cone of 2 x 25.8 = 52 deg. Same wording fix as b18.

b31.note: KE/world = 82 yr; ship time to Alpha Cen = 4.86/2.294 = 2.12 yr.

b34.note: 2 acos(0.99) = 16.2 deg; Moon 1896 arcsec = 0.527 deg (NASA) -> 30.8 -> 31 Moons.

b35.note: P = n v (gamma-1) m_p c^2 = 1e6 x 0.99c x 5.71 GeV = 272 kW/m2; / 1361 W/m2 (NASA solar constant) = 200.

b36.note: Ship time to Alpha Cen 0.623 yr = 7.5 months; galactic centre 26,000 ly / 0.99c / 7.09 = 3,700 yr.

b37.note: Reversal claim checked in calc: visible-band flux of a Sun-like star dead ahead at 99.9% is 0.58x its rest value (fade_999 < 1).

b38.note: 5772 K x D 44.7 = 258,000 K -> 260,000; Wien peak ~11 nm (UV); visible ratio 0.58 (fades).

b39.note: gamma 22.4; ship time to Alpha Cen 0.196 yr = 71.4 days.

b40.note: KE = 21.4 x 420 t x c^2 = 8.06e23 J = 1,360 yr -> 'about 1,400'; exceeds the sum of all previous levels (480 yr): comparison re-derived.

b42.note: McKinley & Doherty, Am. J. Phys. 47, 309 (1979): a properly computed starfield shows no 'starbow'; our render agrees. Brightness/blueness rises toward the centre because D is largest there.

b43.note: CMB 2.725 K (NASA WMAP) x D_ahead 141.4 = 385 K > 373 K (boiling water). Blackbody stays blackbody at T x D.

b44.note: Hypothetical 1 ug grain (stated): 69.7 x 1e-9 kg x c^2 = 6.3e9 J / 4.184e9 J/t = 1.5 t TNT.

b45.note: gamma 70.7; Alpha Cen 22.6 days ship time; galactic centre 368 yr ship time.

b46.note: Callback to the hook sky (same level).

b47.note: 2 acos(0.999999) = 0.162 deg < Moon 0.527 deg; CMB x 1414 = 3,854 K -> 3,850 K, a visibly orange blackbody.

b49.note: 706 x 938.3 MeV = 663 GeV = 0.66 TeV; CERN: 1 TeV ~ kinetic energy of a flying mosquito. Flux n v = 3e14 per m2 per s ('trillions').

b50.note: n v (gamma-1) m_p c^2 = 3.18e7 W/m2 -> 32 MW/m2; 1 ug dust: 706 x 1e-9 x c^2 = 6.3e10 J = 15 t TNT.

b52.note: 26,000 ly (NASA) / 0.999999c / 707 = 36.8 yr ship time: within a human lifetime.

b53.note: Earth time = d/v = 26,000 yr. 'about to look small' sets up b60.

b54.note: Constant proper acceleration of 1 g (9.80665 m/s2) is felt as Earth gravity.

b55.note: Relativistic rocket (Gibbs & Baez), accelerate to midpoint then decelerate: tau = 2(c/g) acosh(1 + g d / 2c^2) = 19.8 yr for 26,000 ly.

b56.note: Same formula for 2.5 million ly: tau = 28.6 yr.

b57.note: gamma_max = 1 + g d / 2c^2 = 1.29e6 -> 1 - beta = 3.0e-13 -> 99.99999999997%, 12 nines; LHC 6.8 TeV protons gamma 7,250 -> 99.999999%; so faster.

b58.note: (gamma_max - 1) M c^2 / world = 82 million years (minimum, perfect engine). 'Not with anything we know how to make' is an honest limit; relativity allows it.

b59.note: Round trip = 2 x 28.6 = 57 yr ship time; 25 + 57 = 82 (leaving age is a scenario choice).

b60.note: Earth time round trip = 2 x 2(c/g) sinh(g tau_half/c) = 5.0 million yr.

b61.note: Ledi-Geraru jaw ~2.8 million years (NPR/Science 2015) < 5 million: comparison re-derived.
